commit 94eedf3dded5 (""tracing: Fix race where eprobes can be called before
the event"") fixed an issue where if an event is soft disabled
trigger is being added
column2: there's a small window where the event sees that

column1: there's a trigger but does not see that it requires reading the event yet
and then calls the trigger with the record == NULL.
This could be solved with adding memory barriers in the hot path
make sure that all the triggers requiring a record check for NULL. The
latter was chosen.
Commit 94eedf3dded5 set the eprobe trigger handle to check for NULL
the same needs to be done with histograms.
